 Sweden vs. Bosnia & Herzegovina - Head-to-head record
 The history between Sweden and Bosnia & Herzegovina is very recent, with the two nations having crossed paths on only one occasion. This lack of a long-standing rivalry means that every match sets a new precedent for future encounters between the sides, making this an interesting fixture to follow.
 Their sole meeting took place earlier in this same UEFA Nations League campaign. The Sweden vs. Bosnia & Herzegovina match, held in Zenica, ended in a hard-fought 1-1 draw, demonstrating that there is little to separate the two teams on the pitch when they go head-to-head.
 Following their initial 1-1 draw, this return fixture takes on greater significance for both. Playing in front of their own fans, Sweden will see this as a prime opportunity to secure the first victory in the history of this matchup and gain an edge over their opponents.

 Sweden - Looking to continue strong run
 Let’s take a closer look at Sweden’s current situation ahead of this clash. We will examine the team’s recent form and their impressive performances in the UEFA Nations League.
 Recent form
 Sweden enters this match with excellent momentum in the UEFA Nations League. They are unbeaten after four rounds, having secured three victories and one draw to accumulate a solid 10 points. This impressive start has positioned them strongly within their group, showcasing a consistent and effective style of play.
 Their form at the Friends Arena has been particularly formidable in this competition. The Swedes have won both of their home fixtures, finding the back of the net five times while only conceding twice. This demonstrates their ability to make home advantage count and control games effectively in front of their own supporters.
 A major factor in their attack has been Viktor Gyökeres, who has been in clinical form with four goals in four matches . With a full squad available and no injury concerns, the team is well-prepared for this encounter. Their current run and attacking threat make them a formidable opponent for any side.

 Bosnia & Herzegovina - Hoping to extend unbeaten run
 Let’s take a look at Bosnia & Herzegovina’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s momentum, expectations, and key players for this upcoming match.
 Recent form
 Bosnia & Herzegovina arrive in Sweden with a solid unbeaten record in this UEFA Nations League campaign. They have accumulated eight points from their first four matches, thanks to two wins and two draws. This strong start suggests they have found a better rhythm in this competition compared to their mixed results at the World Cup earlier in the year.
 Their performances on the road have been particularly impressive, where they remain undefeated. A 4-2 victory against Romania and a 0-0 draw with Poland show they are a resilient and capable side away from home. The fact that they have a fully fit squad with no reported injuries is a significant boost for this difficult trip.
 The team’s goals have been spread out, but midfielder Ivan Bašić has been a standout performer with one goal and one assist. Esmir Bajraktarević has also been crucial in creating chances, providing two assists so far. This collective effort in attack will make them a tough nut to crack.

 Predictions for Sweden vs. Bosnia & Herzegovina - Home Favourites to Win
 Sweden’s formidable home form, powered by the clinical Viktor Gyökeres who has four goals, makes them strong contenders. With their attacking prowess, it is likely we will see over 0.5 goals in the first half.
 Bosnia & Herzegovina arrive unbeaten and have been resilient on their travels, securing a win and a draw. Facing a confident Sweden is a major test, making a “Sweden or Draw” result at half-time a plausible scenario.
 Despite the visitors’ solid run, Sweden’s impressive home record and attacking firepower should be decisive. Our main prediction is for a home victory, backing Sweden to cover the “-0.5 Asian Handicap” market.
